# A fork-only method value saved in a copied Go dependency escapes the
# verifier: logosEjectGcflags covers the main module only, while
# writeEjectedTree copies dependencies too. Eject must refuse it with
# the SPEC T-0.3 reason instead of emitting output upstream Go rejects.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/h2depvalue

go 1.27

require example.com/h2depvaldep v0.0.0

replace example.com/h2depvaldep => ./dep

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"example.com/h2depvaldep/dep"
)

func main() {
	srv := &http.Server{Addr: "127.0.0.1:0"}
	dep.Save(srv)
	fmt.Println("dep value ready")
}

-- m/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/h2depvaldep

go 1.27

-- m/dep/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "net/http"

var saved func()

func Save(s *http.Server) {
	saved = s.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect
	_ = saved
}
